why: I checked all six expect lines and their proofs. Four are CLI runs: `--shout Ada`, `Ada --shout`, plain `Ada`, and `--shout` with no name. Each states exact stdout, stderr and exit code, and each proof is a local `node bin/greet.js` command with od, PIPESTATUS or file redirection, so it can be run at the PR head and gives one answer. The `npm test` line is a run plus a grep and a read of test/, all done at the head. The docs line only needs docs/index.md at the PR head to show a `--shout` example and describe the upper-case output, and its proof is a read of that file. The live site at https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ only exists after merge. It is mentioned only in the outcome text and is explicitly listed under non_goals, so no expect line depends on a deploy, a release or the published page.
